drhp.business: Bliss GVS Pharma Limited, established in 1984 and headquartered in Mumbai, manufactures, markets, trades and exports pharmaceutical formulations - including suppositories, pessaries, capsules, tablets and syrups - for international markets. It is recognised as one of the world's leading manufacturers of suppositories and pessaries, with a particularly robust footprint in Sub-Saharan Africa, which the Company states accounts for more than 80% of its sales volume.

risks.note: The Board's Risk Management Committee charter explicitly scopes information and cyber security risk within its risk-identification framework, reflecting the Company's reliance on digital systems across its operations.
The Risk Management Committee's policy framework separately designates sectoral risk and sustainability/ESG-related risk as categories requiring board-level identification and monitoring.
Financial and operational risk are named as core categories under the Company's formal Risk Management Committee policy, framed under Regulation 21 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

During FY26 the Managing Director (Mr. Gagan Harsh Sharma) and two Whole-Time Directors (Dr. Vibha Gagan Sharma and Mrs. Shruti Vishal Rao) resigned from the Board, with a new MD & CEO (Mr. S. N. Kamath) and two new Independent Directors appointed within the year, indicating an unusually high degree of leadership churn.
